motion_sweep.padding_role: sampling-interval motion protection only; not counted in the numerical envelope and not subtracted from the margin

margin.formula: e_i = eps_position + (|offset_i| + r_upper) * eps_psi + r_upper * eps_relative_heading, maximised over segments and vehicles; the legacy checker expands each body side by (margin - baseline)/2, so the required closure is (margin_used - baseline)/2 >= max_i e_i, equivalently margin_used >= baseline + 2*max_i e_i
margin.radius_upper_note: radius_upper is an outward interval square root of the actual checker half extents (length+margin)/2 and (width+margin)/2 at the recorded margin; it is not the old fixed-point radius.  The margin is solved at this same expanded radius.
margin.unit_note: The legacy FormationCollisionChecker uses half extents (shape_dimension + margin_m)/2.  A full-width margin increase delta therefore grows each side by only delta/2.  error_envelope reserves 2*max(e_i) of full-width margin so the actual per-side growth covers the numerical envelope.  Sweep motion padding is a separate sampling-interval protection and is never counted as numerical margin.
